description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableSubjects' which implements the 'Subjects' interface. It manages a collection of 'Subject' objects, provides methods for creating instances from a collection or JSON, and supports JSON serialization. The class includes functionalities for adding, removing, and retrieving subjects, ensuring immutability and thread safety.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjects
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Subjects interface for managing Subject instances within the project.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableSubjects instance from an iterable of Subject objects, ensuring no duplicate SubjectIds.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an ImmutableSubjects instance from a JSON object, parsing each Subject from JSON fields.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the Subject matching the given SubjectId.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Returns a new Subjects instance with the specified Subject added or replaced.

methods.name: removeSubject
methods.description: Returns a new Subjects instance with the Subject identified by the given SubjectId removed.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the collection of subjects is empty.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Subjects collection to a JSON object based on a schema version and predicate filter.
